For three colors, the 81-state matrix with 342 explicit transitions gives a bijective closed-walk count at every n>=3. An exact Newton-identity calculation of all 81 characteristic coefficients yields the stated determinant factorization, hence the formal log-determinant generating function. The standalone Python exact arithmetic proof script and an independent C++ direct enumerator agree in all checked small cases. No finite experiment is substituted for the all-n transfer identity.

The 2023 primary source treats trees and general bounds, while earlier perfect-prism-coloring papers classify only the strict perfect/equitable subclass. A concrete valid non-perfect three-coloring of the triangular prism blocks any implication from the perfect-coloring classifications to this complete census. Targeted searches and scientific comparisons of published records found no dominating result, though unindexed historical computations remain possible.

value.rationale: The 2-limited packing partition number was recently introduced and its optimum-coloring counts on natural cubic cycle prisms were unresolved in the inspected source. The result exhibits a sharp even/odd palette transition and mod-four geometric rigidity, alongside an explicit factored rational generating series for exponentially many odd optimizers. This provides a reproducible exact infinite benchmark for local-capacity graph coloring, beyond trivial parity or isolated values.
